title: Wait for a future value
summary: Dart: Wait for a future value. Change the future value to 6.
introduction: A Future represents a result that may arrive later. await reads that result inside an async function.
learningObjectives: Wait for a future value with Dart

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.

blocks.title: Wait for a future value

blocks.text: The Future completes with 8. await obtains it before print runs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: await belongs in an async function.
